sizing_bounds.reference_bounds: EVCS BESS tiers per PD v3.0; DPV: IEC 61727; Wind: IEC 61400-1 class II

G1.justification: Slack bus anchor for islanded operation

G3.justification: Co-located with Wind W2; empirically rescues 30/38 tie-switch reconfigurations previously rejected for connectivity_worse_than_base (isolates the 100-112 wind-corridor tail without a GFM anchor)

G4.justification: Co-located with DPV PV6 (zone 2); empirically rescues the remaining 6/8 connectivity-rejected topologies not covered by G3 (isolates the 34-48 zone-2 cluster)

G5.justification: Co-located with Wind W1; empirically rescues the final 2/2 remaining connectivity-rejected topologies, completing 38/38 (100%) rescue of the tie-switch reconfiguration search space

G6.justification: Co-located with EVCS E2 (zone 1) -- the only zone with no prior GFM anchor. Set-cover analysis on the pure tie-switch configuration phase (64 raw combinations of the 6 reconfigurable elements, N-1 line-contingency phase excluded) showed a single anchor at bus 1 rescues all 32/32 connectivity_worse_than_base rejections, raising valid topologies from 23/64 (35.9%) to the structural ceiling of 55/64 (85.9%; the remaining 9 are unfixable radiality/duplicate cases). Measured on the corrected 5-real-GFM model (no phantom substation ext_grid at bus 149, fixed 2026-09-01).

fix_log: GFM rescaled: G1 6.0MW/12MWh, G2 3.0MW/6MWh+2.0MW PV (baseMVA=1 artefact removed)

2026-09-01: Added G3(bus105)/G4(bus47)/G5(bus67) GFM anchors, gfm count 2->5. Empirically set-cover-selected via src/opt/tie_switch_reconfig.py connectivity diagnostics: rescues all 38/38 tie-switch reconfigurations previously rejected as connectivity_worse_than_base (87/134 -> ~125/134 valid topologies). n_gfm change invalidates existing trained checkpoint architectures (obs/action dim depends on n_gfm) -- retraining required before reuse. NOT yet verified: tests/test_freq_dynamics_lti.py and data/tie_switch_cache.pkl regeneration.

2026-09-01: Fixed src/env/microgrid_env_dual.py _inject_assets -- from_mpc() was auto-creating an unconstrained (+-200MW) ext_grid at bus149 (MATPOWER REF bus), silently supplying 9-14% of load in every topology and masking real GFM-stranding failures. Now drops any non-GFM ext_grid before wiring GFM sources. Re-measured tie-switch reconfiguration purely on the switch/tie configuration phase (64 raw combinations of the 6 reconfigurable elements; N-1 line-contingency phase excluded from this count): valid dropped from a previously-inflated 87/134 to the corrected 23/64 (35.9%) with 5 GFM. Structural ceiling (radiality/duplicate, unfixable by GFM) is 9/64.

2026-09-01: Added G6(bus1), gfm count 5->6. Set-cover on the 32 configuration-phase connectivity_worse_than_base rejects (corrected 5-GFM model) showed bus 1 (zone 1, the only zone with no prior GFM) alone rescues all 32/32, raising valid configuration-phase topologies to the structural ceiling of 55/64 (85.9%). n_gfm change again invalidates existing trained checkpoints; retraining/re-certification required.

rescale.reason: v3 sized the GFM fleet for the VPP/market study, not for frequency security: 23 MVA of converters on a 3.49 MW peak-load feeder leaves every unit at ~10% loading, so the headroom-scarce region is physically unreachable and every boundary metric saturates.
rescale.rule: uniform scaling of all six units; pi_g, E/P and MVA/MW ratios preserved

unscaled_and_still_oversized.note: Only the GFM fleet is rescaled here. Wind, DPV and EVCS keep v3 sizing and remain far above feeder load; they set the disturbance magnitudes for the campaign and need a separate decision.
